title: camouflage suit
description: This mod adds a camouflage suit to the game, which isn't currently craftable in Survival, but can be used in custom maps.
body:
This mod adds a camouflage suit to the game, which isn't currently craftable in Survival, but can be used in custom maps. I'll warn you that I used the texture from the Survival Instinct mod as a base and slightly modified it. The model itself was made by me

Mods created with MCreator
